headline: Six positions, one with a clear early signal, two that need a question to the lead, none marked up yet.

thesis.statement: Example Ventures backs pre-seed and seed companies in security software, energy and aerospace, pays early-stage prices, and keeps tickets small.

pillars.title: Sector
pillars.text: Security software, energy and aerospace; crypto and real estate are a hard no.

pillars.title: Stage and price
pillars.text: Pre-seed and seed only, normally at or below the norm cap, never above the ceiling.

pillars.title: Lead quality
pillars.text: The lead has a record in the sector and puts in money of their own.

pillars.title: Sizing
pillars.text: A standard ticket, a per-company maximum, and a per-lead annual limit.

thesis.vintage_note: None of these positions was screened by the written gate; read the retro-check with that in mind.

paragraphs: It is too early to speak of performance: five of six positions are locked and the one mark is fee drag.
Kestrel Nuclear is ahead on public signals; Mosaic Freight and Orchid Health show none yet.
strongest: Kestrel Nuclear: pilot reactor design review passed (company claim).
weakest: Mosaic Freight: off-thesis and priced above the ceiling.
Orchid Health: no cap on record.
actions: Ask the lead for Orchid Health's cap and record it.
Re-check Northwind Defense's procurement pilot before Q1.
lessons_for_gate: Four of six tickets came through one lead: the per-lead limit matters.

Kestrel Nuclear.one_liner: Compact fission for remote industrial sites.
signals: Second engineering hire from a national lab.
Kestrel Nuclear.forecast: A priced seed extension above our entry is plausible within 18 months.

Lumen Shield.one_liner: Identity threat detection for small security teams.
Lumen Shield.forecast: Seed round in 2027 if conversion holds.
